nodes.description: Officer at USU PD identified by X user Muppet Masher as the plainclothes man on the Losi rooftop at 12:47 PM; previously USMC marksmanship instructor at Camp Pendleton (2009–2014) and San Bernardino PD officer; subject of a Brady List entry.

nodes.name: Phil Lyman Location Discrepancy
nodes.description: Pastor and security-team member whose interview clip supplies the term "yanking and banking"; host pages him with unanswered questions about the gloves and Brian Harpole's actions.

nodes.name: Unidentified Goth Person in Broderick Companion Photo
nodes.description: FBI Director (per host framing) whose public statement supplies the 12:39 PM / 16-minute FBI arrival figure.

nodes.name: Hospital Routing Discrepancy
nodes.description: X account credited by host with first positively identifying the red-hat and blue-shirt men in the bystander rooftop footage.

nodes.name: Utah FBI Personnel Replacement
nodes.description: YouTuber whose analysis questions Officer Bagley's preliminary-hearing testimony regarding body cam duration and the red-hat man's role.

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell Undercover Role Verification
nodes.description: Turning Point USA figure referenced in host's "pregnancy brain" framing; host also teases tomorrow's segment about hotel accommodations shared with Andrew Kovat and TPUSA staff.

nodes.name: Missing Gloves Origin in SUV Door
nodes.description: Persistent discrepancy: black gloves reportedly recovered from the rear-door pocket of the transport SUV, but Mikey McCoy's footage of Kirk's exit from that same vehicle shows the pocket as empty.

nodes.name: Officer Bagley Rooftop Companion Identification
nodes.description: Persistent gap: Officer Bagley testified he did not know the plainclothes man with a badge and handgun who accompanied him onto the Losi rooftop; bystander footage and online identification now tie that man to Allan Robertson (USU PD) and a second man to Christopher Hawk.

nodes.name: Body Cam Battery Failure Circumstances
nodes.description: Persistent discrepancy: Officer Bagley states his body cam ended because the battery died while he was still on the rooftop; the device had run only 27 min 35 sec, and Nissi's analysis flags that the camera stopped running at a convenient moment relative to the rooftop discovery.

nodes.name: Allan Robertson Brady List Entry / San Bernardino Transfer
nodes.description: Persistent investigative target: Allan Robertson's Brady List entry, San Bernardino PD's documented non-compliance with Brady disclosure, and the apparent 2024 transfer from California to Utah.

nodes.name: US CentCom Iran Crowdsourcing Request
nodes.description: Investigative target: senior US Central Command officer's reported email soliciting "creative and unconventional" ideas to pressure Iran, sourced from CNN reporting.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Primary investigative subject of the series; relevant in this episode as the victim whose case is being reopened.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the NYT op-ed (A-2348) and named in the Vance-referenced grief account.

claims.label: SUV glove pocket was empty when Charlie Kirk exited the vehicle at UVU
claims.claim: Mikey McCoy's arrival footage shows the rear-door pocket of the SUV as empty at the moment Charlie Kirk exited the vehicle, although black gloves were later recovered from that pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check the McCoy footage against police inventory records for the transport SUV and the official glove recovery chain of custody.

claims.label: FBI agents arrived at UVU at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting
claims.claim: Per a Kash Patel public statement played in the episode, the first FBI agents arrived at UVU with chiefs of police at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting, and secured the scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 12:39 PM arrival timestamp against UVU campus entry logs, FBI case file timestamps, and Patel/Dan Bonino interview transcripts.

claims.label: Officer Bagley's body cam ran 27 min 35 sec and ended on the Losi rooftop
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that his body cam footage began at the Hall of Flags and ran 27 minutes 35 seconds, ending while he was still on the rooftop and before crime tape was placed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the body cam file metadata and manufacturer battery-life specifications to verify whether 27 minutes is plausible as a battery depletion event.

claims.label: Officer Bagley could not identify the plainclothes man who went with him to the Losi rooftop
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified at the preliminary hearing that he did not know the identity, agency, or origin of the plainclothes individual wearing a badge and carrying a handgun who accompanied him up the Losi building stairs.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Bagley's testimony against UVU campus credentialing logs and the bystander footage in A-2227.1.

claims.label: Plainclothes man on rooftop had a badge and a handgun
claims.claim: Officer Bagley confirmed under preliminary-hearing questioning that the second individual who accompanied him onto the Losi rooftop appeared to have a badge and was carrying a handgun.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Bagley's badge-and-handgun description with the bystander footage to verify whether the same individual matches both Bagley's testimony and the visual identification.

claims.label: Bystander footage at 12:47 PM shows Officer Bagley and a second plainclothes man on the Losi rooftop
claims.claim: Bystander footage timestamped 12:47 PM captured Officer Bagley and a second plainclothes man (red hat, bag with badge, backpack) on the Losi Center rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the bystander clip's timestamp and original camera metadata, and run the red-hat figure against UVU/USU event credentialing records.

claims.label: Red-hat man on Losi rooftop identified as Allan Robertson of USU PD
claims.claim: Per an X post by Muppet Masher, the red-hat man visible in the 12:47 PM bystander footage was identified as Allan Robertson of the Utah State University Department of Public Safety.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Robertson's identification through facial comparison, event credential records, and corroborating witness statements.

claims.label: Blue-shirt man on Losi rooftop identified as Christopher Hawk
claims.claim: Per the same Muppet Masher identification, the blue-shirt man walking near the Losi rooftop was identified as Christopher Hawk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Hawk's presence and role through credential records and follow-up witness interviews.

claims.label: Allan Robertson joined the USU police force the summer before the Kirk shooting
claims.claim: A USU Department of Public Safety Facebook announcement, displayed in the episode, states that Allan Robertson had joined the USU police force the summer prior to the September 2025 shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Facebook post metadata (date, author) and corroborate with USU PD hiring records.

claims.label: Allan Robertson was a US Marine Corps marksmanship instructor at Camp Pendleton, 2009–2014
claims.claim: Per Robertson's LinkedIn profile (verbally referenced), he served as a marksmanship instructor for the Marines at Camp Pendleton from 2009 to 2014 and was deployed in Afghanistan and humanitarian work in Japan.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull archived versions of the LinkedIn profile and cross-check against Marine Corps service records.

claims.label: Allan E. Robertson has an entry on the Brady List website
claims.claim: The Brady List website contains an entry for Allan E. Robertson associated with San Bernardino Police Department.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying Brady disclosure record via CPRA / public records request to San Bernardino PD, or via prosecutorial discovery channels.

claims.label: San Bernardino Police Department is listed as not in compliance with Brady disclosure obligations
claims.claim: The Brady List website notes that San Bernardino PD is not in compliance with its Brady disclosure obligations, leaving offense details for officers (including Robertson) undisclosed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the non-compliance notation through Brady List's own documentation and California's Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) records.

claims.label: US Central Command officer emailed a request for creative and unconventional ideas to pressure Iran
claims.claim: A CNN report described an email from a senior US Central Command intelligence-branch officer, sent on a Wednesday to a broad group of military analysts, soliciting new creative and unconventional ideas for pressuring Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original CNN article and any underlying Pentagon / CENTCOM releases; identify the originating office and the recipient distribution list.

claims.label: Erica Kirk stated she does not know what Charlie Kirk would think about war with Iran
claims.claim: In a media clip played during the episode, Erica Kirk stated that her husband is not here to say whether or not the US should be at war with Iran, and that she personally does not want US boots on the ground or American kinetic involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original media appearance (outlet, date, full context) and confirm the quote is unedited.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk called war with Iran "pathologically insane" in archived footage
claims.claim: Archived Charlie Kirk video clips played in the episode describe bombing Iranian nuclear facilities and going to war with Iran as "pathologically insane."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original source videos (date, outlet, full clip) to confirm context and that the clips are unedited.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk stated "This is Israel's war" in archived footage
claims.claim: An archived Charlie Kirk clip lists prior US military interventions and characterizes US confrontation with Iran as "Israel's war."
claims.investigative_direction: Source the original archived segment to verify date, venue, and full context of the statement.

claims.label: Frank Turk claims he "yanked and banked" while the group arrived at the hospital parking lot
claims.claim: In a Frank Turk interview clip, Turk uses the phrase "yanking and banking" to describe what the group was doing as they pulled into the hospital parking lot with Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Frank Turk interview and clarify what "yanking and banking" refers to in context (procedure vs. colloquial expression).

claims.label: Nissi's analysis asserts Officer Bagley's testimony omits key interactions with the red-hat man
claims.claim: YouTuber Nissi's analysis asserts that Officer Bagley failed to mention (a) the red-hat man alerting him to the holster, (b) any pre-rooftop conversation with the red-hat man, and (c) the suspicious timing of his body cam stopping at a convenient moment.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-listen to Bagley's preliminary-hearing testimony in full and cross-check against UVU campus surveillance for any pre-rooftop interaction.
